description: More texts in DECtalk's spelling mode, written after the first corpus showed that a spelled word keeps its form class: verbs, auxiliaries, nouns and adjectives in several places of a clause, each of the six auxiliaries first in a sentence, a wh-question, a conjunction in a long sentence, written commas, words the text parser rewrites, runs of white space, a tab; and the mode command with one word, with a wrong word, with its words in the wrong order, taken away by another mode's set, and inside a text. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.
